We found an ancient ornament,
so we came to report!

A picture of flowers, is it...
a very carefully drawn picture.

As if you could grasp it...
wait, hold on, this picture...

As I thought...
pictures of extinct flowers are mixed in.

One might call it the Treasure Craft...
Anyway, this is a new discovery!

<TALK 1><NAME 1><CV 1,10><CHAR 1,0,1,3,0>You did it, Hunter!
